question: What features characterize the divine form shown to Arjuna?
premises: The form has many mouths, eyes, and wondrous sights.
It has many divine ornaments and raised weapons.
inference: The verse piles up plural divine features to convey overwhelming cosmic multiplicity.
uncertainties: Long compounds are kept as single tokens.
plain_english: Many mouths and eyes, many wondrous sights; many divine ornaments; divine, many raised weapons.
